notes.title: Update Notes for 0.8.3
notes.content:
Some minor fixes to improve on the previous version (0.8.2)


 Mannequin (Monster) will not spawn in the first day
 Recycler back in the House
 Players get 200 gold at the start
 Players get 1 extra torch, 1 extra dungeon codex and 1 extra spell book
 Healing Wand now fires a healing bullet to heal your teammate
 Guidebook will open when player enters the game session
 Watcher (Monster) now emits a sound
 Shop items unlock earlier
 Other minor improvements

notes.title: Update notes for Alpha 0.8.2
notes.content:
Thanks to the feedback from players, we made a large number of improvements to the game. More details on why in the community post in the main Cursed Companions store page.

Major updates:
New look for the Companions
Monsters don't spawn when portal opens, instead their spawn is delayed at random (meaning players can encounter them when they head back home)
Improved the user interface. More help and instructions to guide new players.
Players can host public game sessions
Random spawn points for portal (closer in to the castle in early stages) and for dark shrine
Added a new wing to the Island (for players to test magic spells and figure out the traps)
Added Push To Talk (other players can't hear you but curse words, monsters still trigger)
Increased inventory slot by 1
Added Monster Guidebook

Other improvements:
Moved the Recycler to the new wing of the Island
Added 8 new gestures: thumbs down, thumbs up, etc
Added new dance moves
Host can kick players in public games
Mists and fog now in mustard yellow, green, light blue
Added noise cancellation threshold slider
Added fireworks when the game is successfully completed
Reduced Death Curse damage to 10
Improved pick up distance for objects
Added some furniture players can move around
Increased door opening UI trigger distance
Added beacons which can be triggered with magic words, to guide your way to the main entrance and side entrance
Added spike traps and poison traps
Added ability to restart the game at the Game Over screen with the same players
Added a notification when the warning bell tolls (when there are 3 mins left till the Day ends)
Made more items available at the Shop at the start
Removed the intro video
Notification shown to the person who killed team mate with the cursed word
Showing ping value for debugging
Brightness bar reduced to 0.4 from 1.0
improvements made to animation and other cosmetic improvements
Changes made to the Mandrake's behaviour (smaller listening range, less easy to trigger)
Removed magic spell phrases too hard to trigger
Removed cursed words which were mistakenly triggered
Improve the activation circle for the traps (previously if two or more players are standing on the trap, it does not activate well)
Added a healing wand
Improvements to the magic words rotation syncing for Teleport Stone and Portal Clock
More monsters spawn in the forest (as the portals are now closer to the castle)

As always, please keep the valuable feedback coming. We thank you for your support! :)

notes.title: Update notes for 31 Oct Build
notes.content:
Hello, just a small patch, please refer to previous build patch notes for more details on the changes.


 Fixed the teleport stone issues
 Added a noise cancelling bar in the Settings

KNOWN ISSUES:


 Dead/Spectating players can trigger curses if they are near other live players
 Players who join the game when the portal has been opened may encounter several issues
 Monsters may get stuck due to minor pathing issues
 On rare occasions players may fall through the dungeon due to some unseen gaps
 If you are too close to the Red entrance doors, they can't open. You have to stand slightly back monsters
 New windows exe icon
 Added the Crimson Forge logo
 Fixed issue where players have problems picking up stuff under the dead companions
 You can buy furniture in the shop, but some of their functionality is not completed, so for now they are decorative

notes.title: Update notes for 29 Oct 2024 Build
notes.content:
Hello playtesters, several major improvements to the game:

We received feedback that the Abyssal Lands were too large and the dungeon entrance was hard to find. We have made some changes to make the journey shorter, but kept the map size to encourage exploration. 

Please see the community post for more details.


 Players now spawn at random locations (closer to the dungeon entrance for earlier stages) in the Abyssal Lands 
 Bestiary (Monster) added to the Guidebook. Whenever you get killed by a monster, the book is updated with the monster information
 Navigational beacons added in the Abyssal Lands. If you say the spell "Show me the way", the beacon will light up to show you the entrance to the dungeon. If you say "I want to go home", another beacon will light up the way back to the portal
 Added a feedback form link - https://forms.gle/j7DGBgyTzo2CVnfi6
 Reduced damage on several monsters
 New windows exe icon
 Added the Crimson Forge logo
 Fixed issue where players have problems picking up stuff under the dead companions
 You can buy furniture in the shop, but some of their functionality is not completed, so for now they are decorative


KNOWN ISSUES:

 Players who join the game when the portal has been opened may encounter several issues
 Monsters may get stuck due to minor pathing issues
 On rare occasions players may fall through the dungeon due to some unseen gaps
 If you are too close to the Red entrance doors, they can't open. You have to stand slightly back monsters
 New windows exe icon
 Added the Crimson Forge logo

 You can buy furniture in the shop, but some of their functionality is not completed, so for now they are decorative

notes.title: Update notes for Build Alpha 0.0.1.88
notes.content:
We have made significant improvements to the game

 Playtest is limited to Day 3
 Players can choose server to join (e,g USA East, Europe, etc)
 Add Microphone selection at launch
 Added Gregory the Merchant
 Added Coins and Potions
 Improved UI for microphone audio detection
 Added Furniture
 Improve noise cancellation
 Added Poison trap and Spike traps
 Monsters can move across floor traps
 Several bug fixes
